SELECT o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, oi.ITEM_ID AS orderItemId, oi.QUANTITY AS count, oi.UNIT_PRICE AS price, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, pi.IMG_URL AS imgUrl,
GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT(poi.ITEM_NAME, ': ', pov.OPTION_VALUE) ORDER BY pov.SORT_ORDER, pov.OPTION_VALUE_ID SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS optionName,
pay.PAY_ID AS payId, pay.AMOUNT AS totalPayAmount, pay.PAYMENT_KEY AS paymentKey
FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID JOIN product p ON oi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID
LEFT JOIN product_option_item poi ON oi.OPTION_ITEM_ID = poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN product_option_item_value poiv ON poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID = poiv.OPTION_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN product_option_value pov ON poiv.OPTION_VALUE_ID = pov.OPTION_VALUE_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID, IMG_URL FROM product_img WHERE IS_MAIN = 'Y' ) pi ON p.PRODUCT_ID = pi.PRODUCT_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM payment WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY PAY_ID DESC LIMIT 1 ) pay ON o.ORDER_ID = pay.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND o.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND oi.ITEM_ID = #{orderItemId}
GROUP BY o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_STATUS, oi.ITEM_ID, oi.QUANTITY, oi.UNIT_PRICE, p.PRODUCT_NAME, pi.IMG_URL, pay.PAY_ID, pay.AMOUNT, pay.PAYMENT_KEY
